title: Superseded tenant split: endpoint-specific header policy with fail-closed credential routing

outcomes.statement: A request carries the correct endpoint header policy, and a credential routed to the wrong capability is rejected before any network call is issued.
outcomes.demo: An Analytics key routed to a user-management endpoint throws before fetch is reached; an Admin key on the same endpoint issues a request carrying the expected headers.

uncertainties.statement: No live Anthropic credentials exist; the live provider probe is blocked on per-org keys and invite-canary authorization.
uncertainties.resolution: Scope is deterministic fixtures backed by Pact consumer contracts. Live acceptance stays gated behind the authorized provider run named in the parent story's AC4.

uncertainties.statement: AC1 is a single criterion covering both credential separation and rate limiting, so this child alone does not satisfy it.
uncertainties.resolution: AC1 is satisfied only when US-059 and US-060 have both landed. Closing this child on its own must not be read as meeting AC1; the sibling carries the other half.

uncertainties.statement: Probe code under scripts/probes/** cannot be imported: that path is exempted from the provider-boundary lint for the probe only.
uncertainties.resolution: Header-policy semantics are ported into packages/connectors/src/providers/anthropic/, the other exempt path, and re-implemented against the connector's own contracts.

uncertainties.statement: CHG-052 permanently superseded this tenant-only, never-minted split ID; its intended outcome was delivered canonically by US-056 and US-058, and IMP-378 forbids re-minting this ID with new content.

controlling_change.reason: CHG-052 permanently retires the noncanonical 2026-08-15 split IDs after their outcomes were delivered by official children.
